label: E2E QA: every Plane fork GUI change ships with a Playwright spec (pnpm test:e2e)
content:
ESTABLISHED 2026-09-15 after the PSR QA round. THE RULE: any fork change to a user-visible web flow must either extend apps/web/e2e/*.spec.ts or justify in the commit why it cannot be tested there. The suite REPLACES manual browser QA rounds and the flaky ZCode IAB webview (which degrades mid-session: dead screenshots, stale innerText, clicks not landing - never trust it for acceptance).

STRUCTURE (copy this for new projects):
- apps/web/playwright.config.ts - workers:1 (flows share one user-scoped running timer), fullyParallel:false, globalSetup logs in seeded users via storageState.
- apps/web/e2e/: helpers.ts (API arrange/cleanup: createIssue/postComment/createWorklog/setOptionValue/stopTimer/deleteIssue, all through the dev server /api proxy), one spec per flow, README.md.
- scripts/e2e-seed.sh - idempotent: two QA users (qa-visual admin, uat-outsider with workspace-but-no-project membership) + dedicated 'e2e' workspace/project with time tracking + custom properties on. NEVER tests against demo/real data; specs create+soft-delete their own items.
- Root script: pnpm test:e2e.

RUN: docker compose -f docker-compose-local.yml up -d; ./scripts/e2e-seed.sh; cd apps/web && pnpm dev --port 3002; then pnpm test:e2e (E2E_BASE_URL default http://127.0.0.1:3002).

LOCAL-ENV PREREQS THAT BIT US (each cost an hour+):
1) vite dev define does not apply to workspace-package source - the app's API base resolves '' unless the dev server proxies /api AND /auth (committed fix in apps/web/vite.config.ts).
2) apps/web/.env VITE_API_BASE_URL must be http://127.0.0.1:8000 (docker local stack port; was stale 8001).
3) API CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS needs BOTH localhost:* AND 127.0.0.1:* origins - pick ONE host family (127.0.0.1) and use it everywhere or session cookies split across hosts.
4) apps/api/.env APP_BASE_URL controls post-login redirects - point it at the dev server port, not another local app.
5) Sign-in needs CSRF: GET /auth/get-csrf-token/ then POST /auth/sign-in/ as FORM data (not JSON) with X-CSRFToken header; success = 302 WITHOUT error_code in Location; do NOT follow the redirect.
6) Playwright glob '*' does not cross '/' - '**/issues/{id}/?*' not '**/issues/{id}?*'.
7) headlessui dialog roots have no box - assert on dialog content, not the dialog element visibility.
